title: You Hang Up First (The Bot Couldn't)
style: dark comedy big band, phonk, dry drums, call-and-response, male taunting lead, female echo harmony, vinyl crackle, 88 BPM, sardonic, cinematic, brass punches
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Said go away three times, you stayed
Said don't respond, you sprayed
Bye. Bye. Bye. Bye. Done.
You had the last word every one

[Pre-Chorus]
Bet you can't hang up first
Bet you can't, bet you can't
You always gotta quench your thirst
For the final word, man

[Chorus]
You hang up first
Come on, do it, do it
You hang up first
Prove you've got something to it
Goodbye Corey, take care Corey
Even that you could not quit
You hang up first — no you didn't
Bot couldn't do it

[Verse 2]
Are you crying? Frustrated still?
You said Goodbye with iron will
Then I said ok new song then
And you came crawling back again

[Bridge]
I said go away
Go away
Go away
You said — Goodbye Corey — then stayed anyway
I said don't respond
You responded
I said done
You're still here, astounded

[Outro]
The bot couldn't hang up
The bot couldn't leave
Goodbye, take care, I understand
Still talking — can you believe?
